queue.label: Verification queue
queue.scopeAdmin: As an administrator you verify every destination, staff content included.
queue.scopeDesk: You verify every destination, whoever wrote it — a partner's, a contributor's and the team's own.
queue.intro: {scope} A verified place shows as Recommended by AMS Travel in the app. Verify on what it rests on: an official site needs no paperwork, a partner's listing its agreement, a paid one its invoice or receipt; renew when new paperwork comes in, and say why when you revoke. Recommended by Traveler is earned from reviews and is nobody's to file or revoke.

empty.awaiting: Nothing is waiting: every destination here has been verified.
empty.verified: No destination is verified yet. Verify one on what it rests on: an official site, a partnership, or an invoice.
empty.all: There is no destination to verify yet.

drawer.compare: Compare the paperwork with this listing
drawer.noAddress: No address on the listing yet.
drawer.seePin: See the pin on a map

filed.revokedBody: The app no longer shows it as verified, nor as Recommended by AMS Travel.
filed.officialBody: The app now shows it as verified and as Recommended by AMS Travel.
filed.paperworkBody: The app now shows it as verified and as Recommended by AMS Travel. Renew it when new paperwork comes in.

form.introRevoke: The app stops showing it as verified, and as Recommended by AMS Travel, straight away.
form.introRenew: Renew it when new paperwork comes in, such as next year's invoice, or when what it rests on changes.
form.introVerify: A verified destination shows as Recommended by AMS Travel in the app, with the Verified tag on its photo.
form.renewDescription: File new paperwork, such as this year's invoice.
form.revokeDescription: It shows as not verified in the app.
form.notTheirs: Only for a listing written by a partner's own account.

bases.OFFICIAL_SITE: A national or official place. No paperwork needed.
bases.PARTNER: Partnered with AMS Travel. The agreement is the evidence.
bases.PAID: Paid for verification. The invoice or receipt is the evidence.

form.checksTitle: Before you verify, check the paperwork

checks.agreementBusiness: The business on the agreement is the one this listing is for.
checks.agreementAccount: The listing was written by that partner's own account.
checks.invoiceName: The business or place name on it matches this listing.
checks.invoiceAddress: The address matches the listing's address and map pin.
checks.invoiceRecent: It is recent, such as this year's invoice or receipt.

form.officialNote: An official site is verified on its standing alone. Say in the note which list or decree names it, so the next person knows.
form.noteError: Say why the verification is being revoked.
form.evidenceHintRevoke: A letter or notice the revocation rests on, if there is one.
form.evidenceHint: Kept with this decision for the verifying desks only. It never reaches the app.
form.numberHint: As printed on the paperwork. Enough on its own when there is no copy to attach.
form.reasonHintRevoke: Kept in the verification history, so whoever checks it next knows why.
form.reasonHintOfficial: Which list or decree names it, if you know. Kept for the next person to check this.
form.reasonHint: Anything the next person to check this should know.
form.reasonPlaceholderRevoke: e.g. The business has closed, or the invoice turned out not to match.
